strings.doc.karsk_c4p2_order.alt: A violet carbon copy on Irina’s windowsill: “Наряд № 45/С” – special run C-17/45 on Tuesday, one locomotive, one crew, dep. run-round siding 19:40, arr. Kordon-17 23:40, wagon 24 318, escort Dept. T. “Персонал молчит” (The crew keeps silent). Below it, in pencil: “Кто?” (Who?).
strings.doc.karsk_c4p2_work_list.alt: Under yellowed cellophane: “Колонна 4. Прибытие 22.1.1964. До окончания проверки.” Eleven names, illegible. In the margin, in pencil: “Лена, 4, и Мирон, 6 – детдом № 2” and “Вильгельм С. – спецпоселение Север”. Eleven and three make fourteen.
strings.doc.karsk_c4p2_press_notice.alt: A notice with the depot management’s stamp: Tuesday, 18 Feb, 17:30, visit by a representative of the Swedish press. To be shown: the signal (Eng. A. Morozov), the model brigade, the canteen. “Колонна 4 в этот день: задний двор, за брезентом” – someone has underlined the line.
strings.doc.karsk_c4p2_guidebook.alt: Ekdahl’s 1938 guidebook, page 212: “Karsk – bangård och depå”. Inside, upside down, the German half of card 0417 and a tracing on tracing paper: the room at Kordon-17, Door West, Door East, the waiting bench for fourteen. On the folded-over back: “MOROZOV – 0417 – TUE 23:40 – DOOR EAST”.
strings.doc.karsk_c4p2_card_ru.alt: Card 0417, Russian half: “Коваленко Анна Петровна, 1926, Харьков” – returnee, onward to Karsk filtration point, stamp “Принять” (Accept). On the left the notches of the perforation, above them half of a round “C-17” stamp in Cyrillic lettering. Lev’s note: “До 19.30 – обратно в ящик” (Back in the box by 19:30).
strings.doc.karsk_c4p2_card_whole.alt: The whole of card 0417 under the green lamp. On the left, in German: “Lindner, Anna, née Kowalenko … Note C-17: repatriation East, handover Kordon-17, Door East”. On the right, in Russian: “Коваленко Анна Петровна … Принять … Фильтрационный пункт Карск”. The teeth interlock; the round “C-17” stamp closes – half German, half Cyrillic.
